grammar.label: I wish / if only + past simple

explanation.en: Use the past form after 'wish' for a present situation you want to change. 'I wish I had a car' means I do not have one now.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi holatni o'zgartirishni istaganda 'wish' dan keyin o'tgan zamon shakli qo'yiladi. 'I wish I had a car' — hozir mashinam yo'q degani.

grammar.positive_example: I wish I lived nearer the centre.
grammar.negative_example: I wish I live nearer the centre.

l1_notes.uz: 'Koshki' + hozirgi zamon o'zbekchada tabiiy; ingliz tilida o'tgan shakl talab qilinadi.

grammar.label: used to vs would for past habits
grammar.form: used to + base verb; would + base verb
grammar.meaning: repeated past actions and past states

explanation.en: Both describe repeated past actions. Only 'used to' works for past states: 'I used to have long hair', never 'I would have long hair'.
explanation.uz: Ikkalasi ham takrorlangan o'tgan ishlarni bildiradi. Lekin holat uchun faqat 'used to': 'I used to have long hair'.

grammar.positive_example: We used to live by the sea, and every summer we would swim before breakfast.
grammar.negative_example: We would live by the sea.

l1_notes.uz: 'would' holat fe'llari bilan ishlatilmaydi — bu farqni o'zbek tilida hech narsa ko'rsatmaydi.

functions.label: Telling a simple story about the past

exponents.text: Last summer I went to Bukhara.
First we… then we… after that we…
In the end, we decided to stay another day.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: My grandma used to keep all her photographs in one drawer.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Most of them. They have faded, but I cherish them.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Sometimes. I wish it were still in the family.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Nobody. No one has lived there since my grandpa passed away.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It is. In summer we would sit in the garden until midnight.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Every one. I wish I had understood then how precious that was.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Nobody does at that age. That is what makes it precious now.
